summary: Grace Yoon of Northstar Pharma contacted Aegis Cloud Security support because Comply v2's HIPAA auditor package export fails at the packaging step with error 5023, three business days before Northstar's HIPAA audit fieldwork begins. Team lead Priya Patel identified a product bug: exports over the new 2 GB package limit fail instead of splitting into volumes, affecting Northstar's ~2.4 GB evidence library and at least two other large tenants. Priya committed to running a split export from Aegis's side with an integrity manifest, delivered via secure portal by end of day tomorrow. Grace stressed that the June renewal is already at risk, with SentinelShield shortlisted by her CISO after the March outage, and voiced frustration that Comply v2 failed on its first real audit. Elena escalated the case to P1 and committed to looping in CSM Maria Santos.
